findings.detail: Checks prospective claim/event/capture order, ELIGIBLE observed zero, exact outcome-to-history and current Work references, cold absent versus qualified current history, negative prior, changed actual selected operation and unchanged source scope. The checks use actual emitted G3/G4 fields and do not manufacture feedback or execution results.

Requires equal installed and consumed nine-unit budgets, actual 4/3 to 3/4 checks, additional absolute_word_audit and current G3 consumed Work/history linkage; zero provider/effect counts are required.
Controlled unscorable category is explicitly not claimed as an actual transport failure; NO_UPDATE and unchanged qualified history are required.

Entry uses pinned timing.LIMITS operation_seconds for inherited and direct paths and binds started_utc plus that limit to client. Runtime consumes the supplied deadline; current Stage05 bound is 2400 seconds.

Controller constructor now accepts only positive narrowing no later than the existing opened_at+7800 cap. Existing downstream now<operation_deadline and min/reuse validity checks remain unchanged; no existing validity or historical TTL is extended.
All nine new named callback functions exist; ordinary entry observes their loaded source using existing public native callback observer and compares each source SHA with finite manifest pin.
Only fixed ASCII diagnostic identifiers are added; original identifiers and existing closed projection logic remain.

review_scope: Exact root-authored scenario and ordinary integration deltas plus changed controller deadline dependency. G3/G4 implementations and installation/gate safety require their separate independent peer reviews and exact aggregate source inventory.
required_next_checks: One source-admitted isolated ordinary wiring pass using synthetic HTTP model fixtures and real finite native Work, with zero external AUTH/model/SAVE.
Independent actual readback before any owner command or owner admission.
